text:
anya: quick heads-up — ran a 2h pprof on hostpool-3 for the /generate fast-path. seeing ~35-60us extra per request in host-side parse/tokenization. putting notes here for triage.

mike: can you paste the top stacks? rough numbers are fine.

anya: pasted sample from pprof (flattened):
```
host_parse_loop                     45us  30%  token_skein
  tokenize_chunk                    20us  13%
  http2_write_small_chunks          15us  10%
  kvcache_miss_deserialize          10us   7%
net_poll/epoll_wait                 5us   3%
```

sam: hmmm http2 small chunk writes ring a bell — grpc vs http2 client behavior? we saw smallwrites causing syscall churn earlier.

ken: also correlate with KV cache misses — if we hit KVMiss we do an extra parse pass which forces many small writes back to client. I can repro locally if you give the trace id.

anya: trace id r=prod-8a3f. Stack from a hot trace attached. KV miss rate spiked on that host during the run (15% -> 38%).

maria: idea: buffer tokenized frames for up to 4ms or until payload >= 6KB, then flush. keeps latency for short responses the same but groups tiny packets.

jon: ran a short bench with buffering 4ms on a canary: median P95 -> 24ms to 23.3ms, p99 down 1.8%, tokenization CPU delta +1%. overall 6% fewer write syscalls in flame count.

mike: nice. any regressions on streaming semantics? edge cases where flush delay would harm UX?

anya: tests with streaming chat show no visible delta for clients that render per token — we still stream frames immediately for tokens flagged as live (client hint). only grouped non-live tokens.

sam: also looked at batching heuristic: microbatch steering currently triggers at 6 concurrent inflight; lowering to 4 in high-kvmiss mode improves throughput because we avoid spinning small batches.

ken: patch proposal: 1) host-side token buffer for non-live frames (config default 0ms), 2) adaptive microbatch throttle when kvmiss_rate>25%, 3) smallwrites coalesce in http2 write path.

infra-bot: deploy plan template created: https://rwd/infraplans/host-token-skein-buffer-5218887776

maria: I'll draft the canary config and add telemetry for "writev_count" and "kv_miss_rate" per host.

jon: can confirm local perf with synthetic load: writev_count down ~22%, tail latency improved on 8/10 runs. pushing perf logs to the canary channel.

anya: next steps: schedule canary tomorrow 09:00 PT, add rollback if p99 > baseline +5% or kv_miss_rate > 40% during window. tagging @mike @ken for review.

mike: ack. please include a shorter smoke checklist (latency, writev_count, pprof snapshot) and I'll approve.

anya: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
